title: Crisp Tunisian Vegetable Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic vegetable tagine dish from Tunisia, made with crisp vegetables and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a clay tagine or large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and continue to sauté for another 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, tagine spice blend, and crushed red pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve over couscous or with crusty bread.
